description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Critical Damage +50%] to all allies, grants [Attach Water], [Awoken Sharpshooter], and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, causes [DEF, RES and MND -30% (8s)]/[DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)]/[DEF, RES and MND -70% (8s)] if 0-1/2-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive, grants [High Quick Cast 1]/[Instant Cast 1] to all allies if 2-3/4+ FF10 allies are alive

description.name: Critical Damage +50%
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Water
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Water damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Water resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Sharpshooter
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time
